title: transferring
description: The forward-facing morphism that applies the transfer nucleus to an element of a settled fiber Heyting algebra, returning the smallest element already witnessed in every independent one-step extension of the history; it is the future-facing closure of an aperiodic settling's non-stabilizing orbit.

morphism.description: a one-way generative arrow; reflects a settled fiber-algebra element onto the smallest transfer-stable element above it via the forward nucleus delta_t

domain.description: an aperiodic settling - the settled fiber Heyting algebra over a history whose non-stabilizing orbit is closed

codomain.description: the transferring-nuclear-dyad-category - Heyting algebras equipped with the single forward nucleus delta and its extension-witnessed fixed layer
